topics.title: Verducatib (1397-0014) AIRTIVITY Ph3 Bronchiectasis – Accelerated Recruitment & Updated Timeline

background.text: AIRTIVITY Ph3 FSS Jun 16, 2025. Updated timeline: DBL Sep 20, 2027 (14.7 months earlier than initial); CN NDA sub Feb 2028; CN approval best case Feb 2029, base case Aug 2029 (vs initial best Mar 2030, base Sep 2030). Global: 75% sites initiated by Nov 24, 2025; LSR projected Jul 6, 2026 (>1 year ahead of schedule). China randomization 80/201 planned (39.8%); China is global top recruiter.
